method: Read the complete current AttachmentButton implementation and both affected test files, reviewed diffs against the exact approved repair-before copies, checked their SHA-256 values against repair evidence, and traced current media validation, server attachment response metadata, Api cancellation and Dialog/App authentication-suspension callsites. This was read-only crossreview after freezing the independent MCP repair. No tests or probes were executed for this crossreview.

observations.detail: Response identity, metadata size/name/type and raw Base64 are checked before URL allocation. Shared mediaBytes enforces decoded byte size and empty-file policy. Declared image MIME is compared with the detected header format and dimensions; rejected images retain their bounded original bytes and filename as application/octet-stream downloads with rejection text. Text stays literal with a 64 KiB preview cap; audio remains download-only.

src/runtime/attachments.ts public() emits attachmentId/name/mimeType/size, read() appends canonical Base64, upload() enforces current file/name/type/size limits. The new checks match fields emitted by the real local response rather than a fixture-only contract. Unknown MIME values retain an octet-stream download fallback.

Api plus attachmentId gets an object identity; pending request identity, current owner and AbortSignal must all still match before publication. Unmount/owner-change cleanup aborts the old request and revokes only its URL. A stale finally branch cannot clear another request busy state. New owner objects prevent A-to-B-to-A resurrection; displayed errors/previews are gated by owner. Same-owner duplicate dispatch is fenced by the pending ref.

App retains Workspace and its drafts/receipts while authentication is suspended; DialogScope closes modal participation without invoking business onClose and restores it after renewal. Attachment behavior preserves this existing contract for already open or pending reads. The app-lifecycle diff is exactly two fixture metadata additions (attachmentId a, size 5), with all authentication, no-replay, draft and receipt assertions unchanged.

setupNotes: Batched source/diff output was truncated at supporting-callsite text; the complete final test sources and diffs were inspected, and the affected supporting Dialog/runtime/Api/authentication callsites were read separately.
git diff --no-index returned exit code 1 because the expected before/after changes exist; no Git history or previous implementation was consulted.
limitations: No additional tests, browser/audio decoding, provider/model/MCP/network execution, login, SSH or personal home access occurred in this crossreview. Existing 42-test evidence was read and hash-checked, not rerun.
Static review does not establish real browser-decoder or download behavior. Shared mediaMime checks image signatures/dimension headers and is not a full decoder.
This is a scoped repair crossreview, not a complete repository audit or a new clean audit round.
